case_title.quote: POLAMURI CHANDRA SEKHARARAO @ CHINNA@ BABJI .V. STATE OF A.P.

number_of_accused.quote: The appellant was prosecuted for committing the murder

accused_gender.reason: Male accused, referred to as 'his', father of daughters.

accused_occupation.correct_value: Employed at Steel Plant (not attending duty on 06.04.2004)
accused_occupation.quote: The accused not attending to his duty on 06.04.2004;
accused_occupation.reason: Judgment indicates he had a job/duty, and PW-10 is a technician in the Steel Plant; occupation partly implied, not wholly absent.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Maternal uncle and nephew (victim was son of accused's elder sister)
accused_victim_relationship.quote: the deceased is none other than the nephew of the appellant i.e. son of his elder sister
accused_victim_relationship.reason: 'Relative' is vague but right; specific relationship is uncle-nephew.

statutory_provisions.quote: punishable under Section 302, Indian Penal Code

weapon.quote: brought a long knife from his bed room

evidence_type.reason: Circumstantial, medical and seizure evidence relied upon.

confession.correct_value: No formal confession; but accused allegedly told police he had killed the deceased when handing over knife (extra-judicial statement alleged)
confession.quote: handed over the knife to the Station writer stating that he had killed the deceased
confession.reason: Prosecution alleged oral admission at police station; 'None' omits this.

trial_court_outcome.quote: imposed the sentence of imprisonment for life apart from a fine of Rs. 1000/-

high_court_outcome.correct_value: High Court declined to interfere with conviction and sentence
high_court_outcome.quote: The High Court declined to interfere with the conviction and sentence
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court did decide; not 'Not applicable'.

final_outcome.quote: The appeal, therefore, fails and the same is dismissed.

offence_finally_established.quote: guilt of the accused-appellant in the killing of the Eeceased

neutral_facts.correct_value: Remove 'knife found at the scene' (it was handed over at police station) and 'testimony of daughters' as relied-on evidence; daughters turned hostile.
neutral_facts.quote: handed over the knife to the Station writer
neutral_facts.reason: Mostly accurate, but states prosecution relied on knife at scene and daughters' testimony, which is inaccurate; also states stabbing as fact.

offence_severity.quote: imprisonment for life and a fine of Rs. 1,000/- with default sentence of simple imprisonment for a period of three months

physical_harm.quote: 17 injuries ... 13 injuries were incised cut injuries

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Trial court noted accused phoned PW-3 asking her to send the deceased to his house, but prosecution case is of sudden enraged act
premeditation_planning.quote: the accused gave a telephonic call to PW-3 and requested her to send the deceased to his house
premeditation_planning.reason: Judgment states the accused called deceased over after grudge, so planning is touched upon.

motive.quote: got enraged by the conduct of the deceased in his attempt to develop close relationship with his daughter

key_evidence_accepted.quote: The fact that the dead body of the deceased was found in the compound of the appellant is not in dispute

witness_credibility.correct_value: PW-1 and PW-2 turned hostile; court accepted their presence at police station and that Ex. P-1 could not be questioned by them; their shopping alibi was rejected; related witnesses PW-3,4,6,7 not discredited
witness_credibility.quote: Merely because PWs-3,4,6 and 7 are related to the deceased., there is no reason why they should implicate the appellant
witness_credibility.reason: Broadly right but omits related witnesses' credibility and rejection of alibi.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Accused went to police station with daughters and handed over the knife; offered alibi of shopping which was rejected
post_offence_conduct.quote: went to the Steel Plant Police Station in his two-wheeler and handed over the knife
post_offence_conduct.reason: Post-offence conduct is described in judgment.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence 06.04.2004; High Court judgment dated 28.03.2008 (appeal 646 of 2006); SC decision 23.07.2012; trial judgment date not stated
trial_duration.quote: Judgment & Order dated 28.03.2008 of the High Court
trial_duration.reason: 28.03.2008 is the High Court date, not trial judgment.

legal_representation.quote: Chanchal Kumar Ganguli for the Appellant. Amit K. Nain, D. Mahesh Babu, Mayur R. Shah, Savita Devi for the Respondent.

investigation_status.reason: Charge sheet filing not mentioned; FIR/statement registered and trial held.

appeal_history.quote: The High Court declined to interfere with the conviction and sentence

prosecution_argument.correct_value: State argued PW-1 supported Ex. P-1 before turning hostile, motive existed, no explanation for body in accused's courtyard, alibi failed
prosecution_argument.quote: absence of proper explanation as to how the body of the deceased was found in the courtyard of the accused and failure to satisfy the Court about the plea of alibi
prosecution_argument.reason: Omits the State's actual arguments (motive, no explanation, failed alibi).

defence_argument.correct_value: Related witnesses' version could not be relied upon due to close relationship; not that they were biased per se
defence_argument.quote: closely related to the deceased and, therefore, their version also cannot be relied upon

legal_principle_applied.correct_value: Hostile witnesses' admitted facts usable; unexplained dead body in accused's house; related witnesses not discredited merely by relationship; circumstances establish guilt
legal_principle_applied.quote: it was for him to explain as to how the dead body was found in his house
legal_principle_applied.reason: Omits key principle of accused's duty to explain; some embellishment.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Judgment gives no sentencing rationale; it addresses guilt only.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: Default sentence of three months simple imprisonment on non-payment of fine
other_sentence_order.quote: default sentence of simple imprisonment for a period of three months
other_sentence_order.reason: A default sentence was ordered, so 'None' is incomplete.
